newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - '98 EPS of Danish top 20 seen 10 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - '98 EPS of Danish top 20 seen 10 pct up.

text.p: Nine analysts polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Friday forecast average rises of 10 percent in 1997-98 earnings per share (EPS) for stocks on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange's KFX top-20 index.
Topping the list with the highest expected EPS gains were GN Store Nord, Sophus Berendsen and Novo Nordisk, while BG Bank and Jyske Bank received the lowest expectations.
The panel saw GN Store Nord's EPS rising on average 27.4 percent in 1998 from 1997, with Sophus Berendsen up 20.6 percent and Novo Nordisk rising 16.3 percent in the same period.
At the bottom of the EPS growth expectation table, BG Bank's EPS was seen falling 5.4 percent next year while Jyske Bank's EPS was seen dropping 1.64 percent.
